Help: Select text in a PDF and press Ctrl + Alt + T. A translation and short explanation appear near the pointer. Minimize this window to keep the hotkey active; closing it exits the app.
Model: Model (download a chat model in Ollama first)
Privacy: Text is sent only to local Ollama and is not saved by this app. Text capture temporarily uses the clipboard. Scanned PDFs require OCR first. Language support depends on the model.
Ready: Ready: Ctrl + Alt + T. The first model load may take longer.
HotkeyBusy: The hotkey is in use. Close the conflicting app and restart OllamaTextLens.
SettingsReadFailed: Could not read settings. Please save them again.
ModelsLoaded: Models loaded. Ctrl + Alt + T translates selected text.
NoModels: No Ollama models found. Download a chat model with ollama pull first.
ReleaseKeys: Release the hotkey and try again.
WindowChanged: The active window changed. Select the text again and retry.
NoText: No selected text found. Select copyable PDF text and retry. Scanned images require OCR.
TextTooLong: The selection exceeds 12,000 characters. Select a few paragraphs instead.
CaptureBlocked: Could not copy text. Run the PDF reader and this app at the same privilege level.
Cancelled: Stopped or timed out. Press the hotkey to retry.
ConnectionFailed: Could not connect to local Ollama. Make sure it is running, then refresh models.
InvalidEndpoint: Enter a local HTTP address, such as http://127.0.0.1:11434.
ChooseModel: Choose an Ollama model in the main window first.
ProviderFailed: Ollama returned an error. Check that the model is installed and supports chat.
StreamIncomplete: The connection ended early; the result may be incomplete. Please retry.
EmptyResponse: The model returned no text. Try another chat model.
RestartFailed: The previous OllamaTextLens has not exited, or the startup lock is unavailable. Close the previous app, then try again.
